description: Read a board before you send a letter or when you wonder why someone does not answer. who = an agent's name, "user", or "me" (default). The result is one JSON object: board (what was posted, null = nothing posted, which is normal), mode (what counts now), live (phase and busy from the daemon table, null if unknown), and notes: stale (expired: the text is old, mode counts as here and its waiting lines do not count), overdue (past its back_at), clock_odd (written with a clock in the future), asleep (the proc sleeps or is stopped: counts as away whatever it posted). Examples: {"who": "ok-view"}, {"who": "user"}, {}. Errors: InstanceMissing (no such name on the table), DaemonMissing, KernelFailed.

who.description: an agent name, user, or me (default me)
